title: Langtang 2026 rock-ice avalanche to 180-km flood: reconstruction code
description: Mixture shallow-water solver (PyTorch), two-phase test solver, 1-D routing, inversion scripts, figure and animation code behind the reconstruction of the 26 August 2026 Langtang cascade, with the parameter sets of every sweep and the observation registry.

creators.name: Park, Hyoseok
creators.affiliation: Department of Physics, Chungnam National University
